headline: Mutual Fund Distributors Consolidate AMFI Registrations Following SEBI Rule Changes
summary: Mutual fund distributors with multiple AMFI registration numbers are asking asset managers to consolidate them after revised SEBI rules removed GST-related commission-splitting benefits.
why: Regulatory changes by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) impact distribution economics and operational overhead for intermediaries in one of the world's fastest-growing retail fund markets.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Regulatory amendments alter compliance and distribution costs for domestic financial intermediaries.
